answer.book: Vesperæ Groninganæ sive, Amica de rebus sacris colloquia (Amstelodami/Altdorfii, 1698), a Latin book of dialogues on sacred matters: a preface to the reader, an opening introduction, then twenty numbered colloquia, each discussing a Scripture passage or theological question, ending with FINIS.
